title: Gentle Shell rework: today vs proposal
brief: The whole Gentle Shell screen at 180x50 with the same session data: the real capture today and the proposed IDE-in-a-terminal layout (title row, rail as one tinted panel with sections, editor as a titled panel, one status bar), each with numbered notes. Inventory in design/shell-rework/inventory.md.

artboards.title: Proposal
artboards.tradeoff: Every fact once, rows spent on live work; nothing from today is lost, and the Light preset hides empty sections

artboards.title: Hybrid · MAIN
artboards.tradeoff: Same panel plus a tab row that scales to Git, profiles and memory; costs two rail rows and a mode to remember

artboards.title: Hybrid · GIT
artboards.tradeoff: A destination tab open while an agent waits: the alert and the MAIN badge stay visible from any tab

artboards.title: Mobile
artboards.tradeoff: Live work shrinks to one row and opens as a sheet; alerts and the editor stay on screen; the model moves to the title row

artboards.title: Many agents
artboards.tradeoff: One row per agent ordered by what needs you; the rail gets busier, finished work stays collapsed

artboards.title: Many agents · mobile
artboards.tradeoff: The phone counts agents in one row and lists them in the sheet; the question always stays above the editor
